   10 ;  Unlimited Hackers     Copyright 1993
   20 ;
   30 ;  Subroutines:
   40 ;   OPEN    - open new window on screen
   50 ;     input: A - window's number
   60 ;   CLOSE   - close last window
   70 ;   CHANGE  - change current window
   80 ;     input: A - number of new screen's win.
   90 ;   CHOICE  - lets you choice some positions
  100 ;             in current window
  110 ;   MAX qiantity of windows - 4
  120 ;
  130 ;  Auxiliary subroutines:
  140 ;   ADR   - give you address of screen's
  150 ;           attribute & 1st line
  160 ;     input: HL - koords (L=0..255,H=0..192)
  170 ;     output:HL - address of attribute
  180 ;            DE - address of 1st line
  190 ;   PRINT  - print texts on current window
  200 ;            PRINT use IBM's font
  210 ;     input: DE - begin of text (end - #00)
  220 ;   STRELA - lets you use arrow
  230 ;     output: (XX) - X position
  240 ;             (YY) - Y position
  250 ;   DRAW   - draw window with shadow
  260 ;     input: HL - koords left-up (L=X,H=Y)
  270 ;            DE - length (E=X,D=Y)
  280 ;            BC - shadow's & window's attrib.
  290 ;   BORDER - draw border for window
  300 ;     input: (KOORDT) - koords left-up
  310 ;            (LENT)   - length of window
  320 ;   POSIT  - define address of any screen's 
  330 ;            point
  340 ;     input: HL - koords of point
  350 ;     output:HL - address of this point
  360 
  370        ORG  $
  380        ENT  $
  390        LD   A,1
  400        CALL OPEN
  410        CALL PAUSE
  420        LD   A,2
  430        CALL OPEN
  440        CALL CHOICE
  450        CALL PAUSE
  460        CALL CLOSE
  470        CALL CHOICE
  480        CALL PAUSE
  490        CALL CLOSE
  500        CALL NORMA
  510        RET
  520 
  530 PAUSE  EI
  540        LD   B,50
  550 PAUSE1 HALT
  560        DJNZ PAUSE1
  570        RET
  580 
  590 NORMA  LD   A,#3F
  600        LD   I,A
  610        IM   1
  620        RET
  630 
  640 WIN_S  DEFB #08,#05;XY koords left-up corner
  650 ;                   of 1 window
  660        DEFB #10,#05;XY length of 1 window
  670        DEFB #30,#00;window's & shadow's
  680 ;                   attributes of 1 window
  690        DEFW TEXT1;begin address of text,
  700 ;                 printing with open 1 win.
  710        DEFW CASE1;begin address of bytes,
  720 ;                 for choice of 1 window
  730        DEFB #0B,#07; 2 WINDOW
  740        DEFB #0B,#0C
  750        DEFB #20,#01
  760        DEFW TEXT2
  770        DEFW CASE2
  780 TEXT1  DEFB #0D; text fo 1 window
  790        DEFM " We are kings !"
  800        DEFB #16,#04,#03
  810        DEFB #8A,#AE,#E0,#AE,#AB,#A8," ","!"
  820        DEFB #00; end of text for 1 WINDOW
  830 TEXT2  DEFB #0D
  840        DEFM " Unlimited  Hackers "
  850        DEFB #7F,#0D,#0D
  860        DEFM " All right  reserved"
  870        DEFB #00
  880 ; OPTIONS FOR 1st WINDOW
  890 CASE1  DEFB #02,#01,#01; LENGTH & XY KOORDS
  900 ;                     FOR 1st OPTION
  910        DEFB #03,#04,#01; -~~- FOR 2nd OPTION
  920        DEFB #05,#08,#01; -~~- FOR 3rd OPTION
  930        DEFB #08,#04,#03; -~~- FOR 3th OPTION
  940        DEFB #00 ; TERMINATOR
  950 CASE2  DEFB #0B,#00,#01 ; FOR 2nd WINDOW
  960        DEFB #0B,#00,#02
  970        DEFB #0B,#00,#04
  980        DEFB #0B,#00,#05
  990        DEFB #00
 1000 KOORD0 DEFB 0,0
 1010 ADDRT  DEFW FREE
 1020 SCRWIN DEFS 48

 1040 SCRT   DEFB #00
 1050 KOORDT DEFW #0000
 1060 LENT   DEFW #0000
 1070 ATTRT  DEFW #0000
 1080 CASET  DEFW #0000
 1090 FIRE   DEFB #00
 1100 XX     DEFB 100
 1110 YY     DEFB 100
